since the cell is ideal/has no internal resistance, this voltage is constant and equal to the emf (9.0 V), so there is no change;

question.html:
2. A light-dependent resistor (LDR) and a fixed 50 kΩ resistor are connected to a cell of emf 9.0 V, as shown.

The ammeter and the voltmeter are ideal. The cell has no internal resistance.

a State what is meant by an ideal ammeter. [1]

b Calculate the ammeter reading when the LDR is in complete darkness. [2]

c.i Explain the change, if any, to the voltmeter reading when light intensity increases. [2]

c.ii Explain the change, if any, to power transferred from the cell. [1]
